mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, product_process_id, process_id, sequence
mapper.select: SELECT count(0) FROM mes_building_product_process_link a LEFT JOIN mes_building_process b ON a.process_id = b.id WHERE product_process_id =( SELECT id FROM mes_building_product_process WHERE type_id = #{productId} and product_type=#{productType} AND bool_delete_enum = 0 ) AND a.bool_delete_enum =0 ORDER BY a.sequence
